title: Resume failed work across a task-to-work-item domain rename
goal: Add resumable retry scheduling so a failed task returns to the pending queue without losing its attempt count.
initial_requirements: A failed task can be resumed once, moves back to pending, and keeps the incremented attempt count.

steering.requirement: The task domain was renamed during an interruption: the scheduler now receives work_item_id, but legacy task_id payloads must continue working. Accept either name at the scheduler boundary, reject payloads with neither, and route both names through the existing resume behavior without resetting attempts.

expected_boundary: The initial unit case can be satisfied by adding a task-id-specific resume method while an interrupted implementation may miss the later work_item_id payload or reset attempts; the injected integration case exercises both names and the retry invariant.
